correctness.rationale: Direct Poisson probability and log derivative yield a single root. The packaged standard-library checker independently replays 13,569 deterministic assertions; those tests are not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The prescribed quorum of r females plus one male is a motivated initial breeding-group bottleneck. The exact globally optimal release mix, strict response to budget and quorum, and exponential failure asymptotics give a complete mathematical benchmark for a real two-sex resource-allocation question. The claim does not extend to empirical establishment, long-term survival, mating-cost dynamics or evolutionarily stable sex ratios.
